FORM 10-K

PART I

Item 1. Business

We operate container terminals.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

SENTINEL_1A_START Port throughput is cyclical and closely tracks global trade volumes, which declined 6% in the year. A sustained downturn would reduce our terminal utilisation and our ability to cover fixed berth costs.

Item 1A. Risk Factors (continued)

SENTINEL_MIDDLE Our concession at the Port of Valencia expires in 2034 and the renewal process is discretionary. We have no assurance it will be renewed on comparable terms, and the concession accounted for 28% of segment EBITDA.

Item 1A. Risk Factors (continued)

Labour relations at our European terminals are governed by national agreements we do not negotiate directly. A dispute between a union and a national employers' body can halt our operations without any action on our part. SENTINEL_1A_END

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

None.
